commitMessage: Keep inventory's logger and push path from cloning checkout and notification.
findings: Inventory scored 100 on all four characteristics. Checkout and notification stayed at 100. Platform overall stayed 100 (prior 3dee97d was already 100). A third service at 100 cannot lift a ceilinged mean: mean([100,100]) = 100 and mean([100,100,100]) = 100. The formula would lift a sub-100 estate; at 100 the third service is invisible on overall. The dashboard now shows an inventory chip, so a reader can see three service scores, but nothing on the platform ring distinguishes a new 100 from real improvement. CSI is still one number covering checkout-notification clones and the new checkout-inventory relationship. Reasoner: adk.
